note: Each defect is tied to the exact SHA it was observed on. Fixes are proposed as patches for R01 (or the owning role); R10 does not edit product files. Severity: critical (data loss / unauthorized publication / secret exposure in normal use), high, medium, low.

defects.title: Runtime SQLite (.runtime/) is neither git-ignored nor docker-ignored
defects.repro: In a clean checkout of b2cb2e0: mkdir .runtime && touch .runtime/civic.sqlite3 .runtime/civic.sqlite3-wal && git status --porcelain --ignored .runtime
defects.expected: CONTRACT §3: 'Хранилище SQLite в .runtime/ … без раздачи файла и без коммита DB'; COMMON: не коммитить SQLite с пользователями/private обращения. Status should be '!! .runtime/' (ignored).
defects.actual: '?? .runtime/' (untracked, not ignored): git add . / -A would commit civic_users.password_hash, sessions and private feedback. Dockerfile 'COPY . .' with .dockerignore lacking .runtime would bake the DB into an image. R02 db.py docstring states the folder 'игнорируется Git', which is not true on any pushed branch.
defects.patch: research/round-11-results/R10/patches/R01-gitignore-runtime.patch (git apply --check OK on b2cb2e0; after applying, status is '!! .runtime/')
